description: This Java source file defines the class 'UpsServices' which provides methods for interacting with UPS shipment services, including shipment confirmation and acceptance, handling XML requests and responses, managing shipment data, and integrating with the UPO (Universal Parcel Operations) API within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: UpsServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for UPS shipment confirmation and acceptance in the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: upsShipmentConfirm
methods.description: Processes the shipment confirmation request with UPS, constructs XML requests, sends them, and handles the response to update shipment segments.

methods.name: upsShipmentAccept
methods.description: Handles the final acceptance of shipment with UPS, confirming shipment details and updating the system accordingly.

methods.name: handleUpsShipmentConfirmResponse
methods.description: Parses and processes the UPS ShipmentConfirm response XML, updating shipment route segment details and managing error reporting.

methods.name: handleUpsShipmentAcceptResponse
methods.description: Parses and processes the UPS ShipmentConfirm response XML, updating shipment route segment details and managing error reporting.

methods.name: handleUpsVoidShipmentResponse
methods.description: Processes the VoidShipmentResponse XML, updates shipment route segment status, and reports success or failure.

methods.name: handleUpsTrackShipmentResponse
methods.description: Processes the TrackResponse XML, extracts tracking activity, updates shipment info, and reports status.

methods.name: handleUpsRateInquireResponse
methods.description: Processes the RateInquire response XML and returns shipping rate estimates.

methods.name: createAccessRequestDocument
methods.description: Builds the XML document for UPS AccessRequest, including license number, user id, and password.

methods.name: handleErrors
methods.description: Parses and processes error elements from UPS response XML, accumulates error messages for reporting.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves shipment gateway configuration values from the database or properties.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Overloaded method with default value parameter for retrieving shipment gateway configuration values.

methods.name: getShipmentGatewayConfigValue
methods.description: Internal method to fetch specific shipment gateway parameters from the database or configuration.
